law_name: Copyright Act, 2024 (Act No. 14 of 2024), replacing Copyright Act 2000 (Cap. 18.08)
term_of_protection: Author's life + 70 years (end of calendar year of death; extended from 50; not retroactive for works already protected under the 2000 Act)
enforcement_body: Intellectual Property Office of St. Kitts and Nevis
notes: WPPT in force 8 Oct 2024 per Dutch treaty database; Berne 9 Apr 1995 and WTO 21 Feb 1996 per Commons; WCT unconfirmed; 2024 Act commencement date not seen
